name: tplink
description: Unofficial provider for TP-Link Archer routers using their local web API.

host.description: The router's LAN address, with an optional port. May also be set with the TPLINK_HOST environment variable.

insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Routers serve a self-signed certificate, so this is usually required. May also be set with the TPLINK_INSECURE environment variable. Defaults to false.

password.description: The router's local admin password, as typed into its web UI (not a TP-Link ID). May also be set with the TPLINK_PASSWORD environment variable.

host.description: The router's LAN address, with an optional port. May also be set with the TPLINK_HOST environment variable.

tplink:index:DhcpReservation.description: A DHCP address reservation, plus the name the router displays for the device.

deviceName.description: The name the router displays for the device. Omit to leave whatever name the router currently shows.

enabled.description: Whether the router enables this reservation. Apply always enables it; refresh detects reservations disabled outside Pulumi.

ip.description: The IPv4 address to reserve for the device.

mac.description: The device's MAC address, in any spelling. Normalised to AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF. Changing it replaces the reservation.

deviceName.description: The name the router displays for the device. Omit to leave whatever name the router currently shows.

ip.description: The IPv4 address to reserve for the device.

mac.description: The device's MAC address, in any spelling. Normalised to AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF. Changing it replaces the reservation.

tplink:index:DhcpServer.description: The router's DHCP server record: the DNS handed to clients and the dynamic pool bounds. Every other field (lease time, gateway, domain) is preserved.

poolEnd.description: The last address of the dynamic pool. Omit to leave the router's value.

poolStart.description: The first address of the dynamic pool. Omit to leave the router's value.

primary.description: The primary DNS server handed to DHCP clients.

secondary.description: The secondary DNS server. Omit for none: the router's secondary is cleared.

poolEnd.description: The last address of the dynamic pool. Omit to leave the router's value.

poolStart.description: The first address of the dynamic pool. Omit to leave the router's value.

primary.description: The primary DNS server handed to DHCP clients.

secondary.description: The secondary DNS server. Omit for none: the router's secondary is cleared.

tplink:index:Dmz.description: Whether the DMZ host is enabled. A DMZ host receives every unmatched inbound port.

tplink:index:EasyMesh.description: Whether EasyMesh is enabled. EasyMesh lets satellite routers and extenders join the router's network.

tplink:index:InboundRules.description: Asserts that the router holds no port forwards and no port triggers, removing any it finds.

removed.description: The rules removed by the last apply, as `table: fields`.

rules.description: Rules currently present, as `table: fields`. Empty after an apply.

tplink:index:MediaSharing.description: Whether the router shares attached USB storage as a DLNA media server on the LAN.

tplink:index:NatAlg.description: The NAT application-layer gateways (ALGs). Every gateway is declared, as the web UI writes them together.

ftp.description: Whether the FTP ALG rewrites FTP data connections.

h323.description: Whether the H.323 ALG rewrites H.323 call signalling.

ipsec.description: Whether IPsec VPN connections pass through NAT.

l2tp.description: Whether L2TP VPN connections pass through NAT.

pptp.description: Whether PPTP VPN connections pass through NAT.

rtsp.description: Whether the RTSP ALG rewrites RTSP streaming sessions.

sip.description: Whether the SIP ALG rewrites SIP call signalling.

tftp.description: Whether the TFTP ALG tracks TFTP transfers.

tplink:index:ParentalControlProfile.description: A parental-controls profile that groups devices and can block their internet access while leaving LAN traffic alone.

devices.description: MAC addresses of the profile's devices, in any spelling. Normalised to AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF and sorted.

internetBlocked.description: Whether the profile's devices are cut off from the internet. Their LAN traffic is unaffected.

name.description: The profile name. A profile with this name that already exists is adopted on create.

tplink:index:RemoteAdmin.description: Whether the router can be administered from the WAN side.

tplink:index:Upnp.description: Whether UPnP is enabled. UPnP lets any LAN device open its own NAT hole, unrecorded.
